item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera buys a cell for her torch at a shop in Jaipur. In this cell, the electrolyte is in the form of a moist paste rather than a free liquid, so the cell can be carried and used easily in everyday devices. Which type of cell is this?

options.A: a Voltaic cell, because it always contains a liquid electrolyte
options.B: a dry cell, because its electrolyte is a paste and it is convenient for daily use
options.C: a solar cell, because it uses sunlight to produce current
options.D: a dynamo, because it produces electricity by rotation
